ns2:section.sectionText: Video and Audio postproduction: Provides tools and exercises to learn editing and post production using Adobe premiere pro CC and other adobe tools. Students will be trained on setting up a project and organizing shooting, basic editing, managing clips, trim tools and through the course we will go deeper on postproduction, managing layers, graphic, effects, masks, keyframe, and ultimately experiment on color correction. Students will have the opportunity to work on two specific assignments related to Ebertfest that will be broadcasted in media and screened at the Virginia Theater, Champaign, through the Festival held in April and organized by the College of Media.
